offering_description.value: Operates casual seafood restaurants and package liquor stores, mainly in South Florida, and franchises restaurants under its brand. Sells prepared food and drinks to local diners and packaged liquor to consumers, and also earns franchise fees and rent from leased properties.

primary_products.value: seafood and steak entrees; prepared food; alcoholic beverages; packaged liquor

primary_services.value: restaurant dining; franchise licensing; property leasing

customer_segment.value: B2C: restaurant diners, bar patrons and retail liquor shoppers in South Florida

end_markets.value: restaurants and hospitality; alcoholic beverage retail; commercial real estate

revenue_model.value: product sales: food, drinks and packaged liquor sold at restaurants and stores; licensing or royalties: franchise fees and royalties from franchised restaurants; rental or leasing: rent from leased commercial properties
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: service provider: operates restaurants and takes in food and drink sales from diners; retailer: buys liquor and sells packaged liquor to individual consumers; brand owner: licenses its restaurant brand to franchisees for fees and royalties

geography_served.value: US regional: Florida, mainly South Florida including Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties

specialization.value: related lines: restaurants, package liquor stores and franchising, serving local consumers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned restaurants and liquor stores; partners / resellers: franchised restaurant locations operated by franchisees

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: alcoholic beverage licenses from Florida state regulators and food safety rules for restaurants
